correctness.rationale: Centered symmetric equilateral 2m-gon is unit-segment zonotope with m distinct directions φ_j mod π. Width Fourier modes c_kΣe^(−2ikφ_j) have c_k≠0; R Fourier modes c_k²|F(k)|² recover precisely the circular difference multiset. For m≤3, unordered cyclic gap triples are determined up to dihedral reordering, proving congruence. Sets A={0,1,4,6}, B={0,1,3,7} have each unoriented difference 1..6 exactly once on Z12 but unequal gap multisets; hence noncongruent 8-gons with identical all-lag R. Standard zonotope determinant sum yields area (3+√2+√3+√6)/2 and perimeter 8; exact sign-interval trigonometric integration yields third width moment difference (11√2−3√6−8)/π>0. Support-function calculus implies Area=π(R(0)+R″(0))/4 and Per=π√(mean R). Positive Poisson kernel smoothing preserves Fourier magnitudes and yields analytic support function with everywhere-positive curvature; triple correlation Fourier coefficient gap 32√3/(135π³)e^(−4t) remains nonzero for all t>0. Independent exact difference-set, dihedral checks, bispectral coefficient and integral identities confirmed. The infinite/continuous statements follow the Fourier and geometry proofs, not numerical sampling.
